snippet.title: Incadia (PC) - Gameplay | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Incadia is a Columns-style tile matching game. Like in that classic puzzle, columns of three tiles (totem heads in this game) fall slowly from the top of the screen, and have to be arranged at the bottom. 

▌PC Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieFw3PRaPmrVQ4mTjr4BMRE0
